And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and when the word to be formed denotes a name.

Terms: खच्

The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'who stays there' after the word गम्भीर।

Terms: ञ्य

The nasal of गम् is always elided before क्वि।

Terms: अभीय Rules

The root-vowel of 1. गम् 2. जन् 3. खन् and 4. घस् is elided before an affix beginning with a vowel when it has an indicatory क् or ङ् ; but not before the Aorist affix अङ्।

Terms: कित् and ङित्

An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with स् gets the इट् augment after गम् 'to go' in the परस्मैपद ।

Terms: इट् augment
